component: QuickLoot IE (Ensrick rebuild for Skyrim SE 1.7.104, gamepad Address Library id fix)
purpose: Rebuild of the Ensrick QuickLoot IE fork that no longer freezes on Skyrim SE 1.7.104. QUsingGamepad selected Address Library id 510926 for every runtime >= 1.6.1179, but 510926 (and 68622) are absent from the 1.7.104 version database; only 443396 maps BSInputDeviceManager::IsGamepadEnabled (base game function 67320, RVA 0xCF97B0). The failed lookup when the loot menu first built its button bar drove CommonLib report_and_fail into a MessageBoxW hidden behind the borderless window, then TerminateProcess - the apparent freeze. skyrim-mod-assistant #254.
